scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of cap-constrained dual norm and support; finite checker only supplementary; publication and independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Power-tent family \(r>0\), lattice \((1,\beta)\) with \(0<\beta\le1/2\), essential peak cap; no claims for non-painless lattices or frame condition numbers. An earlier equivalent formula might exist.
title: Sharp peak, sparsity, and \(L^1\)-norm tradeoffs for power-tent Gabor duals
